thread:
lee: Heads-up: Nimbus Gateway listing aiming for 2026-05-05. Need final artifact ingest plan (SOC report, pen test, questionnaire, firmware attestation).

mira: Do they have SOC 2 Type II? If not, can we accept SOC 2 Type I + compensating docs?

lee: Nimbus says they have SOC 2 Type I and an ISO attestation. They offered a recent third-party pen test (Feb 2026) but want to redact customer data.

samir: Redaction ok but require vuln tracker export (CSV) and remediation status. We also need a firmware signing cert chain and firmware checksum list.

noah: For uploads: we'll provide a presigned S3 path per bundle, 48h expiry, SHA256 required. We must also provide a minimal manifest.json describing artifact contents.

claire: I can produce the presign template. Recommend one bundle named nimbus-marketplace-<date>.tar.gz, include manifest, redaction checklist, and questionnaire PDF.

mira: Redaction checklist: strip customer emails, keys, session IDs, and any PII. If partner refuses sealed vault for raw artifacts, escalate.

samir: Pen test ask: include CVSS mapping, whether high/critical fixed or mitigated, and PR timeline. If there are outstanding criticals, hold listing until mitigations accepted by security.

ingest-bot: NOTE: create a release issue and tag #release-war-room before publishing.

lee: Action items: claire -> presign template + manifest sample (ETA 2026-04-20); samir/mira -> acceptance criteria and redaction checklist (ETA 2026-04-20); noah -> confirm presign TTL and bucket policy (ETA 2026-04-19). Please ack by EOD.
